license.notice: Gitleaks is invoked as a separate process for secret scanning. Its binary and sources are not bundled, vendored, or redistributed by Asset Mania.

acquisition.network_boundary: Acquisition happens before any network-deny boundary. No Asset Mania stage downloads gitleaks.
acquisition.official_archives_note: No release archive URL or SHA-256 is recorded because none has been fetched and verified from the official source. A CI job that downloads gitleaks must pin one first.

verified_installs.executable_path_note: Installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/gitleaks on the machine that produced this entry.
verified_installs.verified_by: local `gitleaks version` output and `shasum -a 256` of the executable

scan_scope_note: Gitleaks is a secret scan. It is not evidence about media, model weights, or private sample content; the deny-inventory scan in scripts/check_publication.py covers that separately.
